blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) Episcopal Commission on Inter-religious Dialogue (ECID) welcomed the election of Abdulraof “Sammy Gambar” Macacua as chief minister of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM). “A historic step for the peace process. Mr. Macacua is the first to hold this office in the newly established BARMM government,” said Kidapawan Bishop Jose Colin Bagaforo, chairperson of CBCP-ECID and convenor of the Inter-religious Council for National Transformation (IRLCNT). Bagaforo said the election of Macacua marks the final phase of the full implementation of the Comprehensive Agreement on the Bangsamoro, the peace […]...
